feature.label: Revision Graph for Git (SVN style)
feature.description: A TortoiseSVN-style revision graph for Git inside Eclipse. Commits, local and remote branches, tags and stashes are drawn as connected, color-coded boxes by the same shared web renderer used by the VS Code, Visual Studio and JetBrains hosts.
